why: Each patch is a realistic regression in src/. The harness applies it to a scratch copy of the tool and runs the named subjects and modes (the reference mode always first), stopping at the first red check. A mutant nothing turns red is a gap in the corpus. Patches are cut with -U1 so unrelated edits to src/ rarely break them; test/corpus-mutants.test.mjs fails the moment one no longer applies.

mutants.name: timeout-counted-as-kill
mutants.description: A runner timeout is reported as a kill (the optimistic reading GATE-SEMANTICS rule 3 forbids).

mutants.name: mixed-result-counted-as-kill
mutants.description: Probe runs that disagree (some red, some green) are reported as a kill instead of flaky-defender/inconsistent-probe (rule 4).

mutants.name: baseline-not-required-green
mutants.description: A baseline that is green only some of the time is accepted (rule 1).

mutants.name: fault-not-restored
mutants.description: A fault is left in the tree after it is measured, so the next fault runs on top of it.

mutants.name: reuse-ignores-import-closure
mutants.description: Reuse ignores dependencyHashes: a change to a file the target or defenders import no longer forces a re-measure (rule 8).

mutants.name: reuse-ignores-tool-version
mutants.description: Evidence written by another TestGuard version is carried forward (rule 8, the instrument).

mutants.name: typecheck-skipped
mutants.description: --typecheck reports every fault as clean without running the checker (rule 16).

mutants.name: not-reached-fault-dropped
mutants.description: Under --partial-on-budget a fault the budget never reached is dropped from the evidence instead of being recorded unverifiable/not-reached-within-budget.

mutants.name: fan-out-shares-one-tree
mutants.description: --fault-workers runs several faults at once in the same scratch tree instead of one tree per fault.

mutants.name: negative-control-skipped
mutants.description: The negative control's answer is ignored: a survivor whose defenders never execute the subject stays survived (rule 12).

mutants.name: changed-git-failure-is-empty
mutants.description: --changed treats a reference git cannot resolve as an empty change (exit 0, nothing probed) instead of a precondition failure.

mutants.name: exception-only-reported-as-assertion
mutants.description: A kill made only by exceptions is recorded as an assertion kill, so --require-assertion-kill passes a hollow suite (rule 3).
